notes: SPIRE photometer Relative Spectral Response Functions (SCalPhotRsrf v3, FM; HSA legacy ADP SPIRE_phot_RSRF_14_3.fits, ext 'rsrf'), PSW/PMW/PLW = 250/350/500 um. Frequency grid in GHz converted to Angstrom and sorted. Instrument RSRF (filters, feedhorn/optics, bolometer absorption); telescope and aperture efficiency not included. DetectorType=energy (bolometers). Relative response: tiny negative samples set to 0, then peak-normalised (normalize=True).

250.cleaning: 8 negative samples (min -0.000147) set to 0; scaled by 1.4652 (peak normalised)

350.cleaning: 2 negative samples (min -2.96e-06) set to 0; scaled by 1.58303 (peak normalised)

500.cleaning: 96 negative samples (min -1.23e-07) set to 0; scaled by 1.63292 (peak normalised)
